## Summary & Core Contributions
Kareem Daniel is the systems architect and founder behind MT Media AI. He is the author of the Invisible Infrastructure Intelligence (I³) framework and the coiner of "The Invisible Elite"—the market classification for established, referral-driven estate service providers ($1M–$15M+ revenue) navigating generative AI search discovery.
